rules.description: Applicant must qualify for Child Benefit for the child
rules.reason_if_failed: You must qualify for Child Benefit to receive Guardian's Allowance. Apply for Child Benefit first.

rules.description: The child must not be the applicant's own child
rules.reason_if_failed: Guardian's Allowance is for bringing up someone else's child, not your own child

rules.description: Both of the child's parents must have died, or meet special circumstances for one surviving parent
rules.reason_if_failed: Both parents must have died, or the surviving parent must be untraceable, in prison for 2+ years, or in hospital by court order

rules.description: At least one parent must have been born in UK/EEA/Switzerland or lived in UK since age 16 for 52 weeks in any 2-year period
rules.reason_if_failed: At least one parent must have had a sufficient connection to the UK

rules.description: The child must currently be living with the applicant
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be bringing up the child for them to live with you

rules.description: The child must be under 16, or under 20 if in approved education or training
rules.reason_if_failed: The child must be under 16, or under 20 if in full-time education or approved training

explanation_template: Guardian's Allowance eligibility: {outcome}. This benefit provides £22.10 per week on top of Child Benefit.

edge_cases.description: One parent is alive but their whereabouts are unknown despite reasonable efforts to contact them
edge_cases.action: Require evidence of reasonable efforts to locate surviving parent. HMRC will assess the evidence provided.

edge_cases.description: One parent is alive but imprisoned for at least 2 years from the date of the other parent's death
edge_cases.action: Require prison documentation showing sentence length. Guardian's Allowance can be awarded if sentence is at least 2 years from date of other parent's death.

edge_cases.description: One parent is alive but in hospital by court order
edge_cases.action: Require court order documentation. Guardian's Allowance can be awarded while parent remains in hospital under court order.

edge_cases.description: Guardian has adopted the child after Guardian's Allowance was awarded
edge_cases.action: Guardian's Allowance can continue if it was being paid before the adoption. No new claims allowed post-adoption.

edge_cases.description: Guardian or child temporarily abroad for more than 8 weeks
edge_cases.action: Guardian's Allowance may be affected. Route to HMRC assessment for temporary absence rules.

edge_cases.description: Guardian or child permanently moving abroad (more than 1 year)
edge_cases.action: Guardian's Allowance will stop. Require notification to HMRC Guardian's Allowance Unit.
